name: Mines Laravel
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends php8.3-pcntl php8.3-posix php8.3-zip libzip-dev && sudo phpenmod pcntl posix zip && composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist && npm ci
postCreateCommand: cp .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true && php artisan key:generate --no-interaction 2>/dev/null || true
